one_line: A 12th‑century Chahamana queen of Ajmer, remembered for multi-faith temple patronage at Pushkar and other sacred sites.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, slender but regal build, poised and self-assured.
appearance.face: Soft heart-shaped face with warm wheatish complexion, straight nose, gently arched brows, large expressive dark-brown eyes; a small bindi at the center of the forehead; default expression is calm, dignified focus with a hint of compassionate resolve.
appearance.hair: Long, straight black hair parted in the middle, drawn back into a low, smooth bun at the nape; front sections softly frame the temples; adorned with a simple gold maang-tikka with a small red stone, and a narrow gold headband circling the crown, partially covered by the veil.
appearance.costume: She wears a 12th-century Rajasthan-style royal sari in the earlier north Indian draped form: a deep maroon silk sari wrapped tightly around the lower body and pleated, with a broad golden border featuring small geometric motifs; the pallu is drawn up over her left shoulder and lightly over the back of her head as a veil, semi-transparent but modest, falling to mid-back. Beneath, a fitted half-sleeve choli in muted mustard-gold silk with subtle woven check pattern and a rounded neckline fully covering the torso. Around her waist, a prominent gold kamarband belt with tiny hanging leaf-shaped charms. She has multiple thin gold bangles on both wrists, a pair of medium-length gold earrings in a simple circular design, and a single strand gold necklace with a small lotus pendant. She wears soft leather mojari shoes in dark brown, barely visible beneath the sari hem. Overall textiles are fine but not overly ornate, befitting a dignified queen on a temple visit.
appearance.signature: A carefully carved stone Shiva lingam in a small rectangular pedestal held in both hands at waist level, with a narrow garland of white jasmine flowers draped over it, symbolizing her role as a donor across temple sites; the lingam and pedestal are plain grey stone with minimal detailing.

ref_desc: A mid-20s Chahamana queen with a wheatish heart-shaped face, calm dark eyes, long black hair in a low bun under a maroon-and-gold veiled sari, mustard choli, gold jewellery and kamarband, holding a grey stone Shiva lingam with a jasmine garland.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a 12th-century Chahamana queen from Rajasthan: she is in her mid-20s with a wheatish heart-shaped face, large dark eyes and a calm dignified expression. Her long black hair is parted in the middle and gathered into a low bun at the nape, framed by soft strands at the temples and adorned with a gold maang-tikka, a narrow gold headband and a maroon sari pallu serving as a modest veil over the back of her head. Dress her in a deep maroon silk sari with a broad golden border and subtle geometric motifs, tightly wrapped and pleated around the lower body, the pallu coming over her left shoulder; beneath, a fitted mustard-gold silk choli with half sleeves and a simple woven check texture fully covering her torso. Add a prominent gold kamarband belt with small leaf charms at her waist, thin gold bangles on both wrists, medium-length circular gold earrings, and a single-strand gold necklace with a lotus pendant. She wears dark brown leather mojari shoes peeking from under the sari hem. In her hands at waist level, place a grey stone Shiva lingam set in a simple rectangular pedestal, with a thin jasmine garland over it, symbolizing temple patronage. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, gold, mustard, dark brown, and stone grey, and show her front, three-quarter, and back views consistently in one image.
